verdict.rationale: The evidence pack mentions general 'durability' and retries (hatchet-gh-1) and cron scheduling, but nothing specifically describes a workflow being able to sleep/wait for days-to-months without holding a server, connection, or billable compute — no docs on durable sleep primitives, event-driven resume, or long-duration wait semantics are present. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sleep/wait step API, evidence that waiting workflows release compute/connections, and any examples of multi-day/month durations.
